title: Beamscan Spectrum
source_docs: Phased Array System Toolbox/Direction of Arrival/Beamscan_Spectrum.md
text: Beamscan spatial spectrum estimator, 1 input, 2 outputs, {Geometry} sets Array geometry; {Signal propagation speed (m/s)} sets the signal propagation speed physconst, {Operating frequency (Hz)} sets the system operating frequency 3e8, {Number of bits in phase shifters} sets the number of phase shift quantization bits, {Forward-backward averaging} enables forward-backward averaging, {Azimuth scan angles (deg)} sets the scan angles in azimuth, {Elevation scan angles (deg)} sets the scan angles in elevation, {Enable DOA output} sets the output directions of arrival through output, {Number of signals} sets the expected number of arriving signals, {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted, {Specify sensor array as} sets the method to specify array Array, {Expression} sets the mATLAB expression used to create an array Phased Array System Toolbox™ array System, {Number of elements} sets the number of array elements 2 for ULA arrays and 5 for UCA, {Element spacing (m)} sets the spacing between array elements 0.5 for ULA arrays, {Array axis} sets the linear axis direction, {Array size} sets the dimensions of URA array, {Element lattice} sets the lattice of URA element positions, {Array normal}, {Radius of UCA (m)} sets the uCA array radius, {Element positions (m)} sets the positions of conformal array elements, {Element normals (deg)} sets the direction of conformal array element normal vectors and {Taper} sets the array element tapers. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: X
ports.summary: Received signal M -by- N complex-valued matrix

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: Beamscan 2-D spatial spectrum non-negative real-valued P -by- Q matrix

ports.name: Ang
ports.summary: Directions of arrival non-negative, real-valued 2-by- L matrix

params.name: Signal propagation speed (m/s)
params.values: Signal propagation speed physconst(’LightSpeed’) (default) | real-valued positive scalar

params.name: Operating frequency (Hz)
params.values: System operating frequency 3e8 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Number of bits in phase shifters
params.values: Number of phase shift quantization bits 0 (default) | nonnegative integer

params.name: Forward-backward averaging
params.values: Enable forward-backward averaging off (default) | on

params.name: Azimuth scan angles (deg)
params.values: Scan angles in azimuth direction -180:180 (default) | real-valued vector

params.name: Elevation scan angles (deg)
params.values: Scan angles in elevation direction -90:90 (default) | real-valued vector

params.name: Enable DOA output
params.values: Output directions of arrival through output port off (default) | on

params.name: Number of signals
params.values: Expected number of arriving signals 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Block simulation method Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation

params.name: Specify sensor array as
params.values: Method to specify array Array (no subarrays) (default) | MATLAB expression

params.name: Expression
params.values: MATLAB expression used to create an array Phased Array System Toolbox™ array System object

params.name: Geometry
params.values: Array geometry ULA (default) | URA | UCA | Conformal Array

params.name: Number of elements
params.values: Number of array elements 2 for ULA arrays and 5 for UCA arrays (default) | integer greater than or equal to 2

params.name: Element spacing (m)
params.values: Spacing between array elements 0.5 for ULA arrays and [0.5,0.5] for URA arrays (default) | positive scalar for ULA or URA arrays | 2-element vector of positive values for URA arrays

params.name: Array axis
params.values: Linear axis direction of ULA y (default) | x | z

params.name: Array size
params.values: Dimensions of URA array [2,2] (default) | positive integer | 1-by-2 vector of positive integers

params.name: Element lattice
params.values: Lattice of URA element positions Rectangular (default) | Triangular

params.name: Array normal
params.values: Array normal direction x for URA arrays or z for UCA arrays (default) | y

params.name: Radius of UCA (m)
params.values: UCA array radius 0.5 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Element positions (m)
params.values: Positions of conformal array elements [0;0;0] (default) | 3-by- N matrix of real values

params.name: Element normals (deg)
params.values: Direction of conformal array element normal vectors [0;0] | 2-by-1 column vector | 2-by- N matrix

params.name: Taper
params.values: Array element tapers 1 (default) | complex scalar | complex-valued row vector
